transcript: And one of the women in this group of four has something that's called achondrophobia. For those of you who don't know what that is, that's a fear of little people. Alright? And that shit is real, okay? It's real. And it's not, oh, he's kind of creepy. It's more like, what the fuck is that? Okay? Like, it's nuts. Now, here's the best part of the story. The three friends brought this woman to my show, sat in the front row. All of them knew she had achondrophobia. And they were all just sitting there like, this is gonna be a hoot. Oh my god. Now I'm all for a good practical joke. I love a good prank. Just warn me, okay? If I would have known that this woman was afraid of little people, I would have run on stage wearing a Viking helmet. Like I would have had a good time. Before I even touched the microphone, this woman stands up and in front of the entire audience just goes, Jesus Christ! I'm trying to do a show, a woman yells, Jesus Christ. I start looking around, is Tim Tebow here?
